name: Caroline Chisholm Education Foundation Indigenous Student Scholarship
summary: Covers tuition and associated fees for eligible First Nations students in Chisholm VET courses.
key: For eligible First Nations students, tuition is covered and associated fees are fully funded.
who: Eligible Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students at Chisholm Institute
how: Download the Indigenous Student Scholarship form and email it to ccefscholarships@chisholm.edu.au
catches: Does not cover apprenticeships, traineeships or short courses

evidence.quote: For eligible First Nations students, tuition is covered and CCEF will continue to fully fund associated fees
